name: Good Morning
common_faults: bending knees too much (turning it into a squat)

substitutions.note: bar in hands; similar hinge and hamstring demand
bar from floor; less pure hinge emphasis

contraindications: disc-related symptoms provoked by spinal loading
resistance_profile: hardest at the bottom of the hinge; spinal erectors working throughout

provenance.notes: Higher low-back stress than RDL due to bar placement on upper back. Useful for posterior-chain and spinal-erector strength but requires conservative loading. SFR heuristic.
